name: Warp Zoom Slideshow
description: Full-screen image slideshow with zoom-warp transitions, staggered uppercase caption reveals, an animated slide counter with progress bar, and a custom arrow cursor for browsing.
contents: Full-screen slides with background image and two-line uppercase caption
Series title and description in the top left, hint text in the top right
Slide counter with progress bar at the bottom center
Circular cursor with previous and next arrows
behavior: Navigates by wheel, click on left or right half, arrow keys, or touch swipe, looping at the ends
Slides zoom in or out with an image counter-scale depending on direction
Caption lines slide up with a stagger on each slide
Cursor ring follows the mouse, shows the arrow for the hovered half, and hides after inactivity

props.name: seriesDesc
props.default: Navigate through a visual journey exploring the boundaries between form and emptiness.

editableByProps: Slide images, caption lines and number of slides
Transition duration and cursor idle time
Series title, description and hint text
Font and caption letter spacing classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change overlay colors or caption size
needsCodeEdit.where: js-text-line span className and the fixed overlay divs

fixed: Listens for wheel, click, keyboard and touch on the whole document and window, removed on unmount
Wheel and click navigation applies page-wide, so it should be the only such slideshow on the page
Overlays and the cursor use fixed positioning relative to the viewport
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
